bullets.text: 50 Masts Activated in Wales - **Shared Rural Network** upgrades enhance mobile coverage for rural communities across Wales.
AI Sprawl Needs Solutions - **Equinix** proposes neutral hubs to manage distributed AI workloads and improve network performance.
Detecting Water Leaks with Fiber - **Openreach** uses acoustic sensing technology to prevent water loss in collaboration with **Affinity Water**.
Mobile AI Traffic Surge - AI-related mobile traffic is set to grow significantly, demanding network evolution for telecoms.
Telcos Must Seize AI Opportunity - Telecom operators can redefine their role in the AI economy by offering tailored services.
Horizontal Telco Clouds Essential - **Deutsche Telekom** emphasizes the need for horizontal cloud models to support AI operations.
Cyberattack Hits Ericsson's US Subsidiary - A breach compromises data of over 15,000 individuals, prompting an investigation.
VMO2 Flags 1 Billion Scam Calls - **Virgin Media O2** uses AI to label and block suspected scam calls for customer safety.
AI-Driven Telecom Vision in India - India showcases rapid 5G rollout and AI integration at **MWC 2026**, aiming for intelligent networks.
AI and Digital Divide Discussion - Industry leaders stress the importance of digital skills and infrastructure for equitable AI access.
